data.name: Nurdeen
data.gender_notes: Nurdeen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nurdeen is derived from the Arabic word 'Nur' which means 'Light'. The suffix '-deen' denotes 'religion'. Hence, Nurdeen translates to 'Light of the Religion'. This name is significant in Islamic history as it is a name given to several prominent figures including the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) companion, Abu Hurairah.
data.etymology: Nurdeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the Religion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nurdeen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
